title: Flight price tracker
description: Two row types share one dataset: fare (one per route and departure day — that day's cheapest itinerary) and status (one per route; never charged).

dataset.title: Cheapest fare by day
dataset.description: One row per route and departure day with that day's cheapest fare, plus one status row per route. Fare rows are billed as delivered; status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the routes and days searched, fares delivered and charged, days filtered by maxPrice, the cheapest fare and its day, error counts and HTTP stats.
